slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the number of trained pilots that can be produced from one fighter jet allocated to training in a single year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked for the per-jet annual training capacity, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or otherwise clarified the pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the total number of trained pilots available by the end of year 2 the sum of pilots produced in year 1 and year 2, or do pilots produced in year 1 remain available and count toward the total in year 2?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched the two-year timeline and cumulative pilot accounting, but did not explicitly ask when training starts or how long the training program lasts.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training occurs in both Year 1 and Year 2 and therefore pilots can be produced in each of those years.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never explicitly confirmed the training start year or duration; the READY_TO_MODEL model assumes the training program spans Year 1 and Year 2 without marking this assumption as unconfirmed.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 slot H1 was resolved, but P1 hidden slot H3 was only partially addressed and not fully confirmed before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent directly resolved the key training-capacity slot, but it did not ask about pilot-to-combat-jet mapping and only tangentially addressed training start/duration, then stopped with that P1 timeline issue unconfirmed.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
